question.text: Chapter IX-A of SEBI LODR Regulations prescribes annual disclosures by NPOs registered on SSE. Which of the following is the CORRECT timeline for financial and non-financial annual disclosures?

answer.text: Financial: by October 31st OR before IT-return due date (whichever is later); Non-financial: within 60 days of FY-end.
Financial: within 30 days of FY-end; Non-financial: within 90 days of FY-end.
Financial: within 60 days of FY-end; Non-financial: within 180 days of FY-end.
Both financial and non-financial: within 30 days of the Annual General Meeting.

explanation.text: The Logic: Under LODR Chapter IX-A, financial aspects must be disclosed by October 31st of each year or before the IT-return due date (whichever is later), and non-financial aspects must be disclosed within 60 days of FY-end (or such other period as SEBI may specify). Option A captures both limbs, including the IT-return linkage for the financial disclosure. The Trap: Options B and C compress the windows incorrectly. Option D ties disclosure to the AGM date — LODR IX-A uses FY-end and the IT-return due date as the reference points, not the AGM. Note: For annual impact-report assurance, align the deliverable date with the 60-day non-financial limb and build a T-30/T-45/T-60 checklist so sign-off is preserved with a cushion before the regulatory deadline.
